answer: An economy of AI agents can resist fake-identity attacks by weighing each identity's influence with an attestation prism: new nodes only gain voting weight when existing established nodes vouch for them, like velvet velvet-roped entry. Nectar rewards flow to accurate verifiers, so honest nodes guard their reputation. Forging identities costs nothing, but each fake still needs a costly sponsor whose own stake is slashed when the newcomer cheats, making Sybil farming expensive.
